verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only one-off task submission through the Edison client: create_task, run_tasks_until_done, and async batch submission with later retrieval. Nothing shows a recurring schedule, cron-style trigger, or scheduled workflow feature. A user could wrap these API calls in their own external scheduler, but that is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
